decisions.reason: The spring-balanced desk lamp still fits the ergonomic office portfolio, though desk lamps remain a competitive, non-core niche.
The G2 general interior luminaire is a recent core building-lighting product with its own page, so withdrawal is unlikely.
The microprismatic pendant is a flagship of the firm's efficient, glare-free office lighting direction.
The HMI discharge-lamp searchlight conflicts with the LED strategy, and withdrawing the naval line raises pressure on marine products, but customers still need continuity.
The marine searchlight line serves robust specialist customers with long lifecycles, though the naval line's withdrawal signals some review of marine offerings.
